[B1] < UserX | 'key' : OldKey , ... > $ UserX 'openWindow' cloudA | deviceB
=> < UserX | 'key' : FreshKey , ... > $ cloudA 'openWindow' deviceB | FreshKey .

[B1] < deviceB | 'key' : nils , ... > $ cloudA 'openWindow' deviceB | Key
=> < deviceB | 'key' : Key , ... > .

[B2] < deviceB | 'key' : Key , 'trusted' : Trusted , ... > $ UserX 'bind' deviceB | Key
=> < deviceB | 'key' : Key , 'trusted' : (UserX , Trusted) , ... > .

[B3] < deviceB | 'trusted' : (UserX , Rest) , 'on' : false , ... > $ UserX 'turnOn' deviceB
=> < deviceB | 'trusted' : (UserX , Rest) , 'on' : true , ... > .

[B4] < cloudA | UserX : ('device' : deviceB , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'turnOn' cloudA | deviceB
=> < cloudA | UserX : ('device' : deviceB , ...) , ... > $ cloudA 'turnOn' deviceB .

[B4] < deviceB | 'trusted' : (cloudA , Rest) , 'on' : false , ... > $ cloudA 'turnOn' deviceB
=> < deviceB | 'trusted' : (cloudA , Rest) , 'on' : true , ... > .

[B5] < cloudA | UserX : ('members' : Members , 'device' : deviceB , ...) , UserY : ('device' : nils , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'invite' cloudA | UserY
=> < cloudA | UserX : ('members' : (UserY , Members) , 'device' : deviceB , ...) , UserY : ('device' : deviceB , ...) , ... > .

[B5] < cloudA | UserX : ('members' : Members , 'device' : nils , ...) , UserY : ('device' : Association , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'invite' cloudA | UserY
=> < cloudA | UserX : ('members' : (UserY , Members) , 'device' : nils , ...) , UserY : ('device' : Association , ...) , ... > .

[B5] < cloudA | UserX : ('members' : Members , 'device' : deviceB , ...) , UserY : ('device' : DeviceY , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'invite' cloudA | UserY
=> < cloudA | UserX : ('members' : (UserY , Members) , 'device' : deviceB , ...) , UserY : ('device' : DeviceY , ...) , ... > .

[B6] < cloudA | UserX : ('members' : (UserY , Rest) , ...) , UserY : ('device' : OldDevice , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'remove' cloudA | UserY
=> < cloudA | UserX : ('members' : Rest , ...) , UserY : ('device' : nils , ...) , ... > .
